Hidden 1.
Deal 2 damage to a minion.

cards.name: Bolt

cards.name: Reload
cards.rules: Repeat a minion or trinket's rules.

cards.name: Overcharge
cards.rules:
Choose:
- Deal 1 damage to a minion. Deal 1 damage to the target's owner.
- Deal 3 damage to a minion. Deal 3 damage to the target's owner. Deal 3 damage to yourself.

cards.name: Explode
cards.rules:
Destroy a friendly minion.
Deal the first target's power damage to any target.

cards.name: Hail of Arrows

cards.name: Wildfire
cards.rules: On each of your turns, deal 1 damage to all minions and deal 1 damage to each player.

cards.name: Post
cards.rules:
Lasts 2.
When you play an Archer minion that costs 3 or less, it gains Ready, summon a copy of it.

cards.name: Gift
cards.rules: A hero gains control of a friendly minion or trinket.

cards.name: Swords
cards.rules: Give all friendly minions +1/+0.

cards.name: Shields
cards.rules: Give all friendly minions +0/+1.

cards.name: Duel
cards.rules:
Give a minion +1/+1.
A minion loses Ranged.
The first target fights the second target.

cards.name: Tactician
cards.rules: Give a minion -1/-0.

cards.name: Banner
cards.rules: On each of your turns, summon a Footsoldier.

cards.name: Pillage
cards.rules:
Destroy a trinket.
Choose:
- Give all friendly minions +1/+0.
- Give all friendly minions +0/+1.

cards.name: Commander
cards.rules: Summon 2 Footsoldiers.

cards.name: Rally
cards.rules:
Summon 2 Footsoldiers.
Give all friendly minions +1/+0.

cards.rules:
Hidden.
Ranged

On your next turn, draw 1 card and destroy this card.

cards.name: Study

Draw 2 cards.
Discard 1 card.

cards.name: Summon Primordial
cards.rules:
Return all cards a hero controls to their owner's hand.
Summon a Primordial.

cards.name: Bubble
cards.rules: When your hero is attacked, return the attacker to its owner's hand and destroy this card.

cards.name: Bubble Shield
cards.rules: Summon 2 Bubbles.

cards.name: Morphosis Chamber
cards.rules:
On each of your turns, choose:
- A friendly minion gains Ranged.
- A friendly minion gains Hidden 1.
- Give a friendly minion +1/-1.
- Give a friendly minion -1/+1.

cards.name: Overwork
cards.rules:
Lasts 3.
Gain 3 energy.
On each of your turns, gain 2 energy and draw 1 card.
When this card is destroyed, summon a Burnout.

cards.name: Burnout
cards.rules: At the end of each of your turns, deal 2 damage to yourself and discard 1 card.

cards.name: Control
cards.rules: Gain control of an enemy minion.

cards.name: Oozification
cards.rules:
Destroy a minion.
Summon Oozes equal to the target's toughness for the target's owner.
